answer: Propose one paid key per licensed tundra observatory for 60 days. A falcon camera signs a fresh nonce and horizon panorama in a simultaneous surprise audit; independent receivers triangulate its radio reply. Validators reject reused site IDs; if a reply is absent, pay is zero, and a provably forged signed location burns that site deposit. A farm pools software and rents stations, but each added identity still needs a distinct occupied licensed site and live camera for 60 days; borrowed cash cannot make one site serve two keys. Independent surveyors and validators enforce this new rule.
